enums.set_not_compilable_old_args: 1 for Method setter (int,bool,const char*),0 for (const char*,int,bool)
enums.deopt_mode: 0 for genuine VM_Deoptimize::doit,1 for deoptimize_all_marked(nmethod*),2 for DeoptimizationScope::deoptimize_marked
enums.method_dont_inline_mask: Bit mask extracted from Method::_dont_inline bitfield or Method::Flags/MethodFlags enumerator
enums.method_dont_inline_offset: Absolute byte offset within Method of the dont-inline storage unit
enums.method_dont_inline_storage_size: Exact dont-inline storage unit width in bytes from TPI member/bitfield type
enums.callback_poll_bit: Java20 only: immediate extracted from the PDB-named should_process machine test, whose load offset is checked against JavaThread._poll_data plus ThreadData._polling_word.
enums.thread_is_java_slot: Virtual table index of Thread::is_Java_thread()const, extracted from bounded TPI introducing-virtual offset;9/10 exact exported Thread/JavaThread/CompilerThread/VMThread vtable and return-bool audit.
enums.anonymous_klass_offset: Exact anonymous/hidden Klass predicate byte offset, storage width or bit mask from TPI or separately audited9/10 constructor bytes; zero denotes absent predicate.
enums.anonymous_klass_width: Exact anonymous/hidden Klass predicate byte offset, storage width or bit mask from TPI or separately audited9/10 constructor bytes; zero denotes absent predicate.
enums.anonymous_klass_mask: Exact anonymous/hidden Klass predicate byte offset, storage width or bit mask from TPI or separately audited9/10 constructor bytes; zero denotes absent predicate.
enums.hidden_klass_offset: Exact anonymous/hidden Klass predicate byte offset, storage width or bit mask from TPI or separately audited9/10 constructor bytes; zero denotes absent predicate.
enums.hidden_klass_width: Exact anonymous/hidden Klass predicate byte offset, storage width or bit mask from TPI or separately audited9/10 constructor bytes; zero denotes absent predicate.
enums.hidden_klass_mask: Exact anonymous/hidden Klass predicate byte offset, storage width or bit mask from TPI or separately audited9/10 constructor bytes; zero denotes absent predicate.
enums.deallocate_list_size: Exact size of the GrowableArray<Metadata *> reached through ClassLoaderData::_deallocate_list; PDB-resolved pointer target and flattened bases, or separately audited9/10 allocation and access bytes.
enums.deallocate_list_data_offset: Absolute GrowableArray payload-pointer member offset from the actual resolved TPI target and bases, or exact9/10 access bytes.
enums.deallocate_list_data_width: Exact payload-pointer storage width in bytes from TPI or independently audited9/10 machine loads/stores.
enums.deallocate_list_length_offset: Absolute GrowableArray length-member offset from the actual resolved TPI target and bases, or exact9/10 access bytes.
enums.deallocate_list_length_width: Exact length storage width in bytes from TPI or independently audited9/10 machine loads/stores.
enums.frame_scan_legacy_cld_arg: 1 when the exact PDB signature takes OopClosure*,CLDClosure*,RegisterMap*,bool;0 for the four-machine-argument scanner. Stripped9/10 verified at exact caller and scanner bytes.
enums.frame_scan_small_maps: 1 when all three RegisterMap/SmallRegisterMapType<0>/<1> template instantiations are present in the matching PDB;0 for the ordinary scanner.
enums.frame_stack_slots_relative: 1 when the exact PDB-named interpreter_frame_monitor_end getter unconditionally adds FP to the signed monitor-top slot multiplied by8;0 for absolute or heap-frame-only conditional conversion. Applies to physical monitor-end and nonzero last_sp slots; heap frames are excluded by the runtime.
